target.graphic: Straight-set serif ALABAMA (charcoal-heather fill, crimson outline) + circular University of Alabama seal rising behind letters + charcoal ALUMNI ribbon banner below
target.color: MUST be a shade of gray. Ash / light heather ideal; charcoal viable. Hard pass on red/crimson, white, cream/ivory, oatmeal, sand/tan, black — color is gated before graphic.
target.blank: Jerzees Super Sweats (Russell Corp, Alexander City AL, WPL 7332), Made in USA, ~50/50 +5% other fiber
target.priceGuide: 20-50 USD typical comp; up to ~75 for exact match
target.colorRule: Added 2026-08-30 at Drew's direction: a non-gray sweatshirt is not a viable option regardless of how exact the print is. Non-gray items may be logged as documentation comps but never surfaced as candidates.

channels.notes: Facebook Marketplace unblocked 2026-08-30 when Drew signed the Chrome profile into Facebook. FB relevance collapses under sortBy=creation_time_descend — use default (suggested) sort, and sweep local pickup separately from shipping. | 2026-08-31: FB image srcs are unreadable from JS (blocked) — screenshot the results grid instead. Etsy/eBay/Depop/Grailed/Poshmark grids are best eyeballed by injecting a labeled grid into a live marketplace tab (file:// previews render as static snapshots and never load images). | 2026-09-03: Mercari DID render in the in-app Claude Browser this run (item titles live in the card , not the anchor text) — the 'real Chrome only' note is no longer absolute. Facebook was the only blocked channel. Verify eBay liveness with the JSON-LD schema.org availability string, NOT innerText phrase matching — eBay's inline scripts contain both 'This listing has ended' and 'Buy It Now' on every page and produce false positives either way.
